name: devlog-monorepo
description: devlog: automated build-in-public tool. Monorepo containing the core daemon/CLI, the Electron shell, and the dashboard UI.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @devlog/core && npm run build -w @devlog/dashboard && npm run build -w @devlog/electron
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @devlog/core && npm run typecheck -w @devlog/core && npm run typecheck -w @devlog/electron && npm run typecheck -w @devlog/dashboard
scripts.electron:dev: npm run build:core && npm run build:dashboard && npm run dev -w @devlog/electron
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run package -w @devlog/electron
